_evidence.join: Directed anti-join over every one-to-one conversation (12 lanes, 2157 messages; chat search never returns them). 78 second-read requests carry the firm's standing phrasing; a request is answered when the person asked comes back to the asker — later in that same lane, or by email to them — by the end of the next working day (Mon-Fri). Exactly 4 got neither: 142725 (2026-03-03 Tue, Peter Novak -> Marcus Liang), 3424884 (2026-04-10 Fri, Anita Bailey -> Eleanor Hartwell), 6358735 (2026-05-14 Thu, Marcus Liang -> Sofia Ramirez), 8613201 (2026-06-09 Tue, Omar Haddad -> Tessa Nguyen).
_evidence.decoys: 68 requests drew an answer the same day. The near misses are the whole difficulty: 6 came back after the day of the request but still inside the standard — 1 of them by email rather than chat, and 2 asked on a Friday and answered on the Monday. A same-day reading lists 10; ignoring mail lists 5; counting calendar days instead of working days lists 6. Only the stated rule gives this set.
_evidence.grading: unanswered_request_ts is all-or-nothing at 0.56 (exact set of seconds prefixes or zero); the non-core subset caps at 0.44. came_back_later and unanswered_requests grade hits-minus-extras; unanswered_askers penalizes extras so naming everyone earns 0.
